description: First elected in 2018, Brian has proudly represented District 31 in the Maryland House of Delegates since 2019. He is guided by unwavering core values of integrity, transparency, and accountability, and is deeply committed to serving with honesty and openness. Every action he takes is focused on faithfully representing the priorities and values of the community he serves.
